title: Post IDD Marker Result
description: Dry-run body preview or apply result for POSTing a canonical IDD operational marker comment to an issue or PR.

mode.description: Whether the helper previewed a marker or posted it.

type.description: Operational marker type rendered for the comment.

target.description: GitHub object kind receiving the marker comment.

number.description: Issue or pull request number receiving the marker.

body.description: Byte-exact marker body that dry-run would post; omitted in apply mode.

commentId.description: Identifier of the comment created in apply mode.

url.description: URL of the comment created in apply mode.

verdict.description: f4-head-proof only: the decision. post means no proof exists yet and a dry run would post one; proceed means a proof is in place (reused, or posted and read back); stop ends quietly because the claim is not this session's; hold ends and reports.

reason.description: f4-head-proof only: the reason code behind verdict. Null for post; the code of the verdict table (for example reusable, pr-state, post-unconfirmed) or post-rejected otherwise.

proof.description: f4-head-proof only: the proof values derived from the live reads and the claim record. A value is null when its read did not produce one.

pr.description: Number of the merged pull request whose head branch is the claim's branch.

claim.description: The claim ID the proof is for.

branch.description: The branch of the verified active claim.

f2.description: Head SHA of the latest trusted, unedited review-watermark of this claim on the pull request.

branchTip.description: Tip of the local branch ref, read in --worktree.

merge.description: The merge commit SHA of the live pull request.

head.description: The head SHA of the live pull request.

nextAction.description: f4-head-proof only: what to do next after a hold, a stop, or a dry run that would post. After an uncertain write it says not to post again and to reconcile by reading the issue comments.

warnings.description: Non-blocking diagnostics reported while preparing or posting the marker. For f4-head-proof they are the one-line causes behind reason (a read the command swallowed, or the error of a rejected or uncertain post); they explain the verdict and never change it.

operationLocal.description: Present for --operation-local. watermarkFields describe snapshot from the same capture. A saved snapshot is not an input.

decision.description: Whether this capture may publish a watermark, defer it because CI is incomplete (required checks not passing, or with none configured the present runs not all passing), or refuse it.

reason.description: Human-readable refusal or deferral text. Null when decision is publish.

snapshot.description: The review-activity snapshot collected in this operation. Watermark fields are derived from this object.

watermarkFields.description: Watermark field strings derived from snapshot. Always an object: a capture whose derivation fails throws before any envelope is printed.

warnings.description: Disposition warnings for this same capture. They do not by themselves publish or suppress the marker. A same-head-activity refusal appends one entry naming the review-body findings that have no thread.
